Below that, centred, the salutation, the signature "addictissimus" and the author's name with his place of origin. No margin notes, no running head, no page number, no catchword.

p.i: V. C. ita me inflammabit, ut plura, Deo annuente,in Ecclesiæ & Reipublicæ utilitatem studiosæ sim juventuti communicaturus.

Faxit Deus Opt. Max. per vulnera sui dilectissimi Filij IESV Christi, ut V. C. diu incolumis subditos regat, & gubernet, Christianas Scholas ad divini nominis gloriam summo amore prosequatur, quo studiosos a-dolescentes V. C. Beneficio ac commendatione, linguis artibusq; ita instituere, imbuere, erudire possimus, ut septicollis Idoli Locu-stis,nuper in Germaniam missis, infirmas a-las acuta forfice olim amputare queat. Amẽ.
Datum BASILEAE à Virgineo partu Anno 1588. Nonis Julij.

page.notes: No marginal notes, running head, page number or catchword on this page. The salutation "CelsV." is as printed; the long s in "CelsV." is read as s. The line-end hyphens in "Locu-stis", "a-las", "a-dolescentes", "di-lectissimi", "in-columis", "Chri-stianas" and "commendatio-ne" are kept as printed.
